items.title: Wall Street Journal: Your Mouth Could Hold the Secrets to a Longer and Healthier Life
items.summary: “Dr. Ana Becil Giglio, a New York periodontist and president of the American Academy of Periodontology, says some of the most promising future treatments for gum disease are aimed at controlling the body’s inflammatory response rather than simply removing plaque or killing bacteria.” Read the full article here.
